verdict: Paid ads have been dark for 5 days; getting them back on is the immediate priority.
narrative: Both Meta and Google Ads stopped running on September 20 and have not spent since — all 95 leads and $1,537 in spend this period came from the three weeks before that. The stoppage is tied to several overdue setup milestones (paid landing pages, creative assets, and CRM configuration) that need to be completed before ads can relaunch responsibly. On the CRM side, leads are arriving but no appointments are being booked and no opportunities are closing, which points to a gap in the intake and follow-up process that is being addressed now. This week's focus is clearing the overdue items so paid channels can go live again; once they do, you should see lead volume resume within days of relaunch.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, all before the ad pause on Sep 20
cost per lead this period, held by Meta's activity in the earlier portion of the window
appointments booked from 109 open pipeline opportunities this period

watch_item.issue: Both paid channels have been dark since September 20, with no new leads generated in the last 7 days.
watch_item.fix: Overdue creative assets and landing pages are being completed this week so Meta and Google can relaunch immediately upon sign-off.
